scripts.test:loop: bun src/cli.ts render test-e2e/loop.wav --output loop.mp4 --size 640x360 --fps 24 --quality preview --seed loop-smoke --fade 0.5 --overwrite
scripts.test:clip: bun src/cli.ts clip test-e2e/loop.wav --output clip.mp4 --title "RESONANCE" --artist "VISU VISU" --seed loop-smoke --quality preview --render-scale 0.25 --overwrite
scripts.showcase:loop: bun src/cli.ts render test-e2e/loop.wav --output test-e2e/loop.mp4 --resolution fullhd --ratio 16:9 --fps 60 --quality final --seed loop-smoke --title "RESONANCE" --artist "VISU VISU" --fade 0.5 --overwrite
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.showcase:portrait: bun src/cli.ts render test-e2e/loop.wav --output renders/resonance-portrait-60.mp4 --resolution fullhd --ratio 9:16 --fps 60 --quality final --seed loop-smoke --title "RESONANCE" --artist "VISU VISU" --fade 0.5 --overwrite
